## Notes

A grid trips when consumption exceeds production and Power Storage is empty, stopping every connected building until the fuse is reset; buildings do not slow during shortages; Power Storage holds 100 MWh; generators from 30 MW (Biomass Burner) to 2,500 MW (Nuclear Power Plant); idle buildings draw 0.1 MW.
